name: deotpdf
description: Read PDFs and write notes on them that DeotPDF opens as its own: in files, or in the document you have open in DeotPDF.
long_description:
deot is the command line of [DeotPDF](https://github.com/errorc0de404/DeotPDF), a PDF note-taking app, as a set of tools.

- **Read**: page sizes, text with positions, existing annotations, empty space, a rendered page.
- **Write**: text boxes, highlights, lines, shapes, pen strokes, images and sticky notes, as real annotations DeotPDF can edit afterwards. The input PDF is never changed; the result goes to a new file.
- **Live**: with a document open in DeotPDF, Claude can look at what you see and write into it directly. DeotPDF asks you first, every edit is one Undo step, and nothing is saved until you save.

Files are limited to the folders you choose below. Nothing is sent anywhere: the tools run on this computer.

tools.name: schema
tools.description: JSON schemas of command inputs and outputs

tools.name: info
tools.description: Pages, sizes, rotation, text layer, annotation counts and file hash

tools.name: render
tools.description: Page, region or page grid as PNG with page-to-pixel matrices

tools.name: text
tools.description: PDF text layer: characters, words and lines with quads

tools.name: annot_list
tools.description: Annotations with kind, bounds, style, text and tags

tools.name: find
tools.description: Phrase candidates in the text layer with characters, quads and context

tools.name: layout
tools.description: Text lines grouped into paragraph and list blocks

tools.name: ink
tools.description: Ink fraction per grid cell and connected ink blocks of the rendered page

tools.name: space
tools.description: Empty rectangle candidates avoiding ink and given areas

tools.name: measure
tools.description: Text box size, lines, fonts and missing glyphs from the app's text engine

tools.name: fonts
tools.description: Font families the text engine accepts

tools.name: check
tools.description: Geometric checks of annotations by rules: regions, overlaps, page edges, text

tools.name: page_export
tools.description: Writes some pages as a PDF of their own

tools.name: apply
tools.description: Runs a list of writing operations atomically and writes once

tools.name: live_docs
tools.description: The documents open in DeotPDF windows now

tools.name: live_context
tools.description: What the user is looking at in DeotPDF: page, visible part, selection

tools.name: live_goto
tools.description: Scrolls the user's DeotPDF view to a page

tools.name: live_flash
tools.description: Scrolls to a place and marks it for a moment

folders.title: PDF folders
folders.description: deot reads and writes PDFs only inside these folders. Relative paths start in the first one. A document open in DeotPDF does not need its folder here.
